title: Your District. Your Data. Your Right.

intro: ForThePeople.in is India's citizen transparency platform, launched in 2026. We aggregate district-level government data — budgets, crop prices, water levels, scheme coverage, infrastructure, and more — and present it in a clear, accessible interface for every Indian. The platform covers {coverage} and plans to expand to all {total} Indian districts.
mission: To make government data as easy to access as checking the weather — so that every citizen, journalist, researcher, and elected representative can engage with governance based on facts.
builderBio: Entrepreneur and civic-tech advocate based in India. Built ForThePeople.in in 2026 as an independent public-interest project to help citizens, journalists, researchers, and elected representatives access India's government data in one place. Not affiliated with any government body or political organisation.
glanceSimple: Today ForThePeople.in is live in {d, plural, one {# district} other {# districts}} across {s, plural, one {# state} other {# states}}. India has {total} districts, and the plan is to cover every one of them.
tileLiveSub: Across {s, plural, one {# state} other {# states}}
whereSimpleEven: Each state has {n, plural, one {# live district} other {# live districts}} so far.
pillar_data_desc: Every number comes from a government portal or another reputed source, and shows where it came from and when. We never make up a number. When a source publishes an estimate or a projection (such as UN population or IMF GDP figures), we say so.
pillar_reach_desc: Currently live in {coverage} — expanding to all {total} districts across India.
pillar_lang_desc: Data is shown in English and the language of each state: Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Hindi and more.
pillar_time_desc: We check each source on a schedule, and every reading shows the date it is for. When a source is late or stops answering, the figure is not refreshed and its date shows how old it is. Budget and census data go back years.
pillar_free_desc: No paywalls, no subscriptions. Government data belongs to citizens. We just make it accessible.
pillar_rti_desc: Don't see what you need? We provide ready-to-send RTI templates so you can get any government information by right.
sourcesBody: ForThePeople.in is an independent citizen transparency platform built on India's Right to Information principles (Article 19(1)(a) of the Constitution). Data comes from central and state government portals (many released under the National Data Sharing and Accessibility Policy (NDSAP) 2012), from research and international bodies (such as IIPS for NFHS, the UN, the IMF and the World Bank) and from other reputed public sources (weather services, market data such as IBJA and Yahoo Finance, and news headlines under fair use). We do not claim affiliation with any government body. Every numeric value is traceable to its original public source — please verify critical information at the source before acting on it.
src_agmarknet: Agricultural Marketing Information Network: crop mandi prices
src_kwrd: Water Resources Department, Karnataka: dam and reservoir levels
src_owm: Current weather readings (Open-Meteo is used when it does not answer)
src_eci: Assembly and Lok Sabha election results and voter data
src_egram: Panchayat and finance data (MGNREGA, district budgets)
src_udise: School enrolment, pass rates, student-teacher ratios
src_pmay: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana housing scheme data
src_ibja: India Bullion and Jewellers Association: gold and silver rates
src_fuel: Petroleum Planning and Analysis Cell, checked against BPCL: petrol and diesel prices
src_yahoo: Market data: Sensex, Nifty, the US dollar and Brent crude oil
src_news: News headlines from newspapers, each linked to the original story
pledge1: Every data point comes from a government portal, a public API, a gazetted document or another reputed source, and shows where it came from and when.
pledge2: If you find an error, please <link>let us know</link>. We will correct it within 24 hours and publish the correction.
disclaimerBody: ForThePeople.in is an independent, non-governmental initiative. It is NOT an official government website. Data comes from public government portals and other reputed sources, and is provided for informational purposes only. For official records, always refer to the original government source.
